meta.name: himalayan_monastery
meta.prompt: A Himalayan monastery clinging to a cliff face above a glacier, prayer flags strung across the gorge, a village of yak herders on the moraine below.

character.label: cliffside Himalayan monastery and moraine herder settlement

programs.brief: A colossal Tibetan dzong assembly fortress clinging to a sheer rock cliff face above the gorge, with battered whitewashed stone walls, dark timber eave bands, golden roof finials, a prayer hall interior, and cantilevered wooden balconies overlooking the glacier below.
A tall weathered wooden mast with strings of colorful Tibetan prayer flags radiating outward across the cliff edge, anchored by a stepped stone mani cairn at the base.

tokens.terrain: a sheer cliff face and deep gorge above a glacier, with a rocky moraine valley floor below
tokens.infra: prayer_flag_lines strung across the gorge; stone_retaining_wall under the monastery terraces; yak_enclosure dry stone walls on the moraine
tokens.icons: whitewashed dzong assembly hall with dark timber banding clinging to the rock; prayer wheel gallery; chortens and mani stone cairns along the approach paths; yak herder stone huts and yak byres below on the moraine
